description: This file defines a template class for HMAC (Hash-based Message Authentication Code) using various hash algorithms. It includes methods for setting the key, resetting the computation, obtaining the result, and inputting data. It also defines specific typedefs for common hash algorithms like SHA1, SHA224, SHA256, SHA384, SHA512, and MD5.

classes.name: HMACType
classes.description: A template class implementing HMAC with a specified hash algorithm, providing key management, input processing, and result retrieval.

methods.name: Key
methods.description: Sets the key for HMAC, hashing it if necessary, and preparing inner and outer pads.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the internal hash algorithm and initializes it with the inner pad.

methods.name: Result
methods.description: Returns the computed HMAC value, performing final hashing if not already done.

methods.name: Input
methods.description: Provides input data to the hash algorithm.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Overloaded operators to input data into the HMAC object.
